subject: Raise loop default tokenBudget + maxIterations for long autonomous runs
description:
Trivial config-constant change so heartbeat loops aren't cut off mid-long-work. The loop stops on spent>tokenBudget OR iterations>maxIterations (daemon.js:902-903); spent += estPerTick(800) per tick (daemon.js:898), so the two caps must stay proportional (5,000,000 / 800 = 6250). Raise BOTH from the current defaults to tokenBudget=5000000, maxIterations=6250 in all THREE places the defaults live:

1. lib/loop-autostart.js — AUTOSTART_CONFIG (lines 11-18): tokenBudget 80000 → 5000000, maxIterations 100 → 6250. Leave minPoll/maxPoll/batch/maxConcurrency unchanged.
2. lib/ready-flag-cache.js:53 — the soft-nudge string literal contains `loop_control({action:"start", tokenBudget:80000, maxIterations:100, minPoll:30, maxPoll:300, batch:4, maxConcurrency:6})` — change tokenBudget:80000 → tokenBudget:5000000 and maxIterations:100 → maxIterations:6250 in that string. Leave the rest of the string verbatim.
3. daemon.js:288 — newLoop() default config `{ tokenBudget: 100000, maxIterations: 200, minPoll: 30, maxPoll: 1200, estPerTick: 800, batch: 8, maxConcurrency: 10, judgeParallelCap: 6 }`: tokenBudget 100000 → 5000000, maxIterations 200 → 6250. Leave estPerTick/minPoll/maxPoll/batch/maxConcurrency/judgeParallelCap unchanged.

Do NOT touch estPerTick (keep 800) — that's the per-tick estimate the proportion is based on. Surgical edits only; no logic changes, no other files. Verify with: node --test test/loop-autostart.test.js (should still pass — the AUTOSTART_CONFIG values are asserted there; the existing test reads AUTOSTART_CONFIG dynamically so it should still pass, but confirm).
